title: Tuesday 24 November
detail:
Due to expected swell and forecast easterly winds, MV Caledonian Isles will operate via Troon to the following timetable:

**Depart** Troon 07:00

Arrive Brodick 08:20

**Depart** Brodick 09:10

Arrive Troon 10:30

**Depart** Troon 11:30

Arrive Brodick 12:50

Service remains liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

A review will take place at approximately 11:00 to determine whether MV Caledonian Isles will continue operating via Troon or resume service to/from Ardrossan.

title: Monday 23 November
detail:
Service will continue to operate to/from Ardrossan until the 18:55 arrival in Brodick this evening.

Due to forecast easterly winds, upon arrival in Brodick the vessel will load and depart as soon as possible before diverting to Troon for overnight berthing:

**Depart** Brodick 19:00

Arrive Troon 20:20

Please note, vehicles may be required to turn or reverse on the car deck due to the diversion to Troon.

Due to an operational issue with the sector light at Ardrossan being inoperable, service is heightened risk of disruption or cancellation from the 16:40 departing Brodick.

A bus will operate from Troon to Ardrossan (via Troon station) at 20:35 this evening.

title: Monday 23 November
detail:
